purpose: Close the broader strongly-log-concave/Lorentzian reweighting shortcut left after the real-stability barrier. Homogenize the five-state rank-3 switch and show that its support is not M-convex, so no positive coefficient reweighting with the same support can be Lorentzian.

homogenized_switch.meaning: This is the degree-two homogenization of 1+L+M+R+LR. Any positive reweighting preserving the exact local five-state support has the same exponent set.

theorem.name: HOMOGENIZED_RANK3_SWITCH_SUPPORT_IS_NOT_M_CONVEX
proof: Take alpha=e_L+e_R and beta=e_y+e_M from the support.
At coordinate L, alpha_L>beta_L. M-convex exchange requires some j with alpha_j<beta_j such that both alpha-e_L+e_j and beta+e_L-e_j remain in the support.
The only possible deficit coordinates are y and M.
For j=y, alpha-e_L+e_y=e_y+e_R is supported, but beta+e_L-e_y=e_L+e_M is not supported.
For j=M, alpha-e_L+e_M=e_M+e_R is not supported.
No exchange exists, so the support is not M-convex.
theorem.lorentzian_corollary: Branden-Huh characterize homogeneous Lorentzian polynomials with nonnegative coefficients as having M-convex support plus the Hessian condition. Since the support condition already fails, no positive coefficient choice on these five monomials is Lorentzian or strongly log-concave.

killed: Repair the exact rank-3 switch by positive coefficient reweighting and then apply Lorentzian/strong-log-concavity mixed-characteristic machinery.
Any local source-preserving route whose only missing hypothesis is M-convex/Lorentzian support.
not_killed: Global homogenizations with additional monomials followed by a genuinely nonlocal exact projection/cancellation.
Signed or complex oriented-P0 constructions outside nonnegative Lorentzian theory.
